care.summary: Unique snake plant with round, spear-like leaves that grow upright; extremely drought-tolerant and low-maintenance.
care.light: Low to bright indirect light; tolerates low light well
care.water: Water sparingly; allow soil to dry completely between waterings
care.humidity: Low to average; tolerates dry air
care.fertilizer: Light feeding with cactus fertilizer in spring and summer
care.toxicity: Mildly toxic to pets and humans if ingested
tips: Water only when soil is bone dry
Use terra cotta pots for better drainage
Wipe dust off leaves with damp cloth
Propagate by leaf cuttings in water or soil
